title: Bitcoin DE
cardSummary: An Android cryptocurrency trading experience built to make a volatile market feel steady and legible.
sub: An Android cryptocurrency trading experience built to make a volatile market feel steady and legible.

cover.alt: Bitcoin DE Android trading app interface

sections.heading: Challenge
paragraphs: Bitcoin.de needed a convenient, trustworthy Android app for cryptocurrency trading — one that supported essential financial workflows while staying approachable for users at any experience level. Key features:

sections.heading: Design Approach
paragraphs: The experience was built around three principles: simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
list: Clear information hierarchy for financial data
Transparent states and confirmations for critical actions

result: The updated Android app expanded Bitcoin.de's ecosystem and attracted more than 10,000 users — giving them a clearer, more convenient way to manage their crypto.
